summary: EnrollmentEditAll is the main orchestration file that renders and manages all aspects of the student cohort enrollment workflow, including filtering, viewing, and editing various enrollment-related records through modular user controls. It handles UI logic, parameter passing, workflow selection, dynamic user control instantiation, filtering, sorting, and manages cohort-specific context across many related screens and components.
purpose: To present, filter, and manage all student enrollment-related records for a cohort, department, program, and course, integrating a wide set of modular controls for Preferences, Confirmations, Certifications, Infection Control, ID Cards, Criminal Records, Forms, and Administrative Comments. It enables coordinators and authorized actors to perform bulk operations and view/edit granular details in a single dashboard.

workflows.name: Enrollment Bulk Edit/View
steps: Page_Load: Setup context, read query parameters.
If PlacementCoordinator or StudentMaint access, set edit mode.
Render department, cohort, term, course, screen mode, and filter context.
Translate comment filter UI with localized values.
Link child controls according to filter and context.
Invoke the correct modular user control based on ScreenMode value.
Pass context (filter, sort, cohort, permissions, etc.) to user controls.
Child controls render filtered lists or details, and support bulk operations.
Page_PreRender: Process page messages, error/warning states.
Page_UnLoad: Clean up session, finalize state.

workflows.name: Modular Record Loading
steps: CRC: Load criminal records check control.
OrientationProviderType / ConfProviderType: Load orientation or form by provider type.
Certification: Load certification control with code.

business_rules: ReadOnly mode is enforced for ViewOnly users unless overridden by PlacementCoordinator or StudentMaint privileges.
Bulk edit and view functions are only available for authorized users.
ScreenMode, Section, Action, and filtering values are derived from query strings and context.
ShowAllPreferences visibility depends on Use3Prefs and ScreenMode.
CommentFilter may be translated to localized values ('Blank', 'NonBlank', 'ALL').
validations: Check for null or empty query parameters, fallback to defaults.
Type conversion for IDs (int for CohortID, TermID, CourseID, Campus).
Checkboxes and filter controls reflect query string or session state.
Sort order and direction validated from query parameters.
H1N1/Covid flags must be set accordingly for each control.
calculations: Sort and Asc values determine ordering in child controls.
GetSection and GetAction functions calculate UI display values.
conditions: If IsPostBack is false, initial context is loaded and controls rendered.
If UserSession.PlacementCoordinator or StudentMaint, editing enabled.
Switch-case on ScreenMode determines which control is shown.
system_behavior: Dynamically shows/hides child user controls based on ScreenMode.
Initializes all controls with filters, context, and permissions.
Processes UI messages and error panels.
Auto-generated designer fields must be moved to code-behind for custom logic.
exceptions: Missing or malformed query string values.
content_gaps: No business logic for individual child controls; only orchestrating/parameter passing.
No detailed field-level validation or exception handling for all modular controls (details exist in those controls, not here).
No process flows describing intra-control interactions, only inter-control orchestration.
No explicit UI layout or styling rules beyond auto-generated fields and panels.
No database query logic; relies on imported DataLayer methods.
